title: Ansem says his Pump wallet was hacked and suspects unauthorized access to his Bullpen account
date_note: Both articles are dated 24 November and give no earlier day.
summary: Crypto trader Ansem said his Pump wallet was hacked and that unauthorized access to his Bullpen profile appears to have occurred, per Bloomingbit citing CoinDesk. Lookonchain's X post, relayed by PANews, says 215만 USDC was transferred to an Arbitrum wallet; Bloomingbit says CoinDesk could not confirm that figure. Wikitree quotes analysts (MLM, Specter, Fabiano, ZachXBT) who say the on-chain pattern does not look like a hack; method and damage were under investigation.
plain: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked and suspects someone got into his Bullpen account. Analysts quoted by Wikitree say the on-chain activity does not look like a hack. The cause and loss are not yet established.
exec: The wallet owner himself reports a hack, but analysts quoted by Wikitree dispute it; the method and total losses are not yet established.

sources.name: Wikitree: 앤셈 지갑 해킹 주장…분석가들 반박

Bloomingbit: 룩온체인 ANSEM 관련 지갑 해킹 정황

evidence.quote: 目前已转移 215 万枚 USDC

validation.note: Bloomingbit (relaying CoinDesk) quotes Ansem's own statement; PANews and an earlier Bloomingbit article relay Lookonchain's X post. The CoinDesk original and the X post were not read.

review.note: figure wording: summary had untranslated 215 万枚 USDC; now 2.15 million USDC as PANews and Bloomingbit state; rest matches sources
